description: List publications you own by cursor, or search the public gallery by page. Your items carry your private tags; tag filters by one. Your first page also carries secretCounts and, when you have one-time secrets, a secrets group; kind secret lists only them (ended picks the group). Results can include author-written titles.

cursor.description: Mine only. nextCursor from the previous result

ended.description: Mine only, secrets. false (default): active secrets, newest first; true: ended ones

expiring.description: Mine only. Expiring within seven days

kind.description: Mine only. Publication kind, or secret

tag.description: Mine only. Exact tag, any case
